title: Enabling high-performance multivalent metal-ion batteries: current advances and future prospects
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00929K, Review Article
Asif Mahmood, Zhe Bai, Tan Wang, Yaojie Lei, Shijian Wang, Bing Sun, Hajra Khan, Karim Khan, Kening Sun, Guoxiu Wang
This review discusses challenges and innovations in multivalent metal-ion batteries, focusing on materials, electrolytes, separators, advanced characterization as well as role of machine learning for high performance, stability, and scalability.
